searchText: hey guys, is blobscan alive on Goerli? we tried getting it up, but seems like the non-finality period made it hard for it to sync up. would need to check with the team if they have a fix or if they plan on running one? Hey everyone. I read through the EIP-4844 and noticed it mentions the blob tx contains `[chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, r, s]`. I am wondering how is the "blob sidecar" sent to the CL node? Furthermore i see that in the Go CLI tool the crafted transaction has a "Sidecar" field: https://github.com/ethpandaops/goomy-blob/blob/52526aa16d49498b72f7f49e958c065a9eaa9e17/txbuilder/blobtx.go#L33 Is it also RLP encoded along with everything else and sent over to the RPC server of the Node? they confirmed to be working on running an instance too Hi <@709649004559859772> we are 6 hours away from syncing our Goerli node. We aim to have the site operational by tomorrow Blob txs take two forms depending on the context. The “network representation” includes the blobs and their commitments in the RLP the other form doesn’t. Network representation is used both for eth_sendRawTransaction (to submit a tx to your node) and for devp2p tx gossip, while the other representation is used “on chain” in the EL (e.g. when including txs in a block body). Correction: the two forms are both “network representations”, the first form with the blobs is called a PooledTransaction with the form without the blob is called the TransactionPayload.
